name: Palo Dinner Roasted Free-Range Lemon & Thyme Chicken
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
searchKeywords: roasted free range lemon thyme chicken
whyItWorks: Since Palo cooks every protein fresh to order, the kitchen can roast this free-range chicken breast with olive oil and sea salt only (zero lemon).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Tell your server to prepare the Free-Range Chicken with olive oil and salt only—strictly no lemon juice or lemon zest—to make it 100% citrus-free and flare-safe.
watchOuts: Standard preparation includes lemon juice/zest unless requested plain
